entries.name: AGROVOC agricultural concepts: six FAO-language content scope
entries.versionBasis: Rolling latestAgrovoc download returned ZIP bytes; exact release/version was not verified. Website news dates are not dataset release dates.

licence.text: CC-BY-3.0-IGO (English, French, Spanish, Arabic, Russian and Chinese content only, per FAO policy)
licence.basis: FAO's access page and FAQ explicitly grant CC BY IGO 3.0 for the six named languages, including attribution and change indication. Other language rights remain separate.

norn.overlap: Agricultural concepts and multilingual labels are sector classification/enrichment, not general Core types.

priority.reason: Industry vertical outside the ERP core; later.
